codecs.rust: rust/contract.rs with actual roswasm alloc,ros2; generated bounded_records module
codecs.javascript: codec_contract.mjs uses actual modules and Node assert only in local test, no Native bridge
codecs.assemblyscript: codec_contract.ts exports runContracts, requires real compiler/module harness and abortGuest route; no automatic invocation
codecs.tinygo: go/codec_contract.go uses actual generated customtypes plus sdk/tinygo, genuine TinyGo ROS2 selection

producer_policy: Use actual existing pinned SDK producer; no compiler executable/IR backend is invented here. All source generation, language compilation, artifact/import gates and Guest/Native tests are unexecuted.
physical_budget: One serial generation command in caller-owned cgroup/process; output and caches private under/tmp. No global cache/SDK/toolchain mutation. Real physical memory/Native allocations require their own measured bound.
qualification: All32 record sources implemented. No Service facade emitted until real owned raw12 layer; canonical/native root facts only.
